_comment: Calibrated for videoplayback.mp4, a 298x640 portrait phone capture. Run tools/inspect_frame.py <video> --grid on a different recording and re-measure.
_slots_comment: The four cards in hand, left to right, as fractions of frame width and height: [x1, y1, x2, y2]. Excludes the 'Next' card and the elixir bar.
_hp_text_comment: Left edge, in source pixels, of the strip holding each enemy tower's health number. The few columns of margin before the digits are deliberate: the HUD shifts a pixel or two between matches and the reader locates the number inside the strip. The rows it searches are fixed in digits.py.
